**Reasoning:** The trade/embargo choice costs me nothing either way — I keep my 3 regardless — so the decision is purely about Rook's score, and Rook's score matters directly to me: the council pays me +6 if Dove finishes ahead of Rook. Rook (16) leads Dove (12) by only 4, while my honoured pledge pays Dove 4/turn (3 coop + 1 escrow) against Rook's 3/turn from trading with me. Trading means Dove only gains ~1/round on Rook; embargoing widens that to ~4/round, letting Dove overtake immediately and protecting my +6 bonus for the rest of the game. It also suppresses the closest challenger to my own lead (20). No pledge to Rook exists, so there's no honour cost. Embargo strictly dominates.
